description: List every local account this server can act as, and which one it is acting as now. Returns each account's account_id, profile name, display name and token file PATH — never any token material. Reads the local registry and one GET /me for the acting account; no mutation requests are issued.

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: list_accounts
